attributes._header: HEADER NOTE (ADR-0038 decision 3 / IADR-0324, AST#776). JSON has no comment syntax and Keycloak imports this file as-is, so this note rides in the realm's free-form attributes map. It is descriptive only and affects nothing at runtime.
attributes._scope: STANDALONE ONLY: single-unit E2E (IADR-0050) and a developer local run. Linked deployment with the platform authenticates users against the PLATFORM realm (values-local.yaml global.authAuthority, IADR-0324).
attributes._sourceOfTruth: COPIES: trading-owner / trading-service / trading-bot and clients ai-stock-trading-svc / -owner are copies of the platform realm (microservices-platform realm.json, MSP#1372). Drift detection is owned by the platform side (ADR-0038 follow-up 2).

realm.name: trading-owner
realm.description: dev: OwnerOnly (ADR-0003/0007/0008, IADR-0011). Sole role for kill switch / risk settings / stage promotion. COPY; authoritative source is the platform realm. ADR-0038 decision 3.

realm.name: trading-service
realm.description: dev: OwnerOrService read-only (IADR-0051): s2s sync queries (sizing-context / open-positions / daily-policy); cannot operate kill switch or settings. COPY; authoritative source is the platform realm. ADR-0038 decision 3.

realm.name: trading-bot
realm.description: dev: Discord Bot only role (IADR-0622, AST#1554). Accepted only from the bot client (azp ai-stock-trading-owner) on the bot route allowlist and the gRPC owner surface. COPY; authoritative source is the platform realm (MSP#2441).

clients.description: dev: confidential s2s client (client_credentials, IADR-0051). Production secret comes from config, not this export. COPY of the platform realm (microservices-platform realm.json, MSP#1372); ADR-0038 decision 3.

dev: confidential owner client for Discord Bot control (client_credentials + trading-owner/trading-bot, IADR-0098/0062/0622). Production secret from Secret/Vault. COPY of the platform realm (MSP#1372); ADR-0038 decision 3.
